15. 
(1)  The  Minister  shall,  upon 
receipt  of  a
recommendation under paragraph (f) of section 14 to declare
an  Investment  Zone,  with  the  approval  of  the  Cabinet  of
Ministers, by Notice published in the Gazette, declare such
Investment Zone by specifying-

(a)
the metes and bounds of the land area which shall
fall within such Zone; and

(b)
the sector in which such zone falls and whether it is
a single sector or multiple sector zone as referred to
in subsection (4).
(2)    Such  land  area  specified  in  the  Notice  published
under subsection (1) shall stand vested in the Zones SL unless
otherwise specified therein and the provisions of the Land
Acquisition Act (Chapter 450) shall mutatis mutandis apply
in relation to any private land which falls within a land area
so specified.
(3) Upon the publication of the Notice under subsection
(1),  the  Zones  SL  shall  be  responsible  for  promoting  the
establishment and supervision of such Zone in accordance
with the provisions of Part III.
